segments.en: Through humility — one's greatness is added upon his greatness.
Through humility — one lengthens one's days.
Through humility — one's deeds are not scrutinized.
Through humility — the fear of enemies is nullified.
Through humility — all are at peace with him.
Through humility — the Holy Blessed One remembers him.
Sometimes through lowliness — when a person humbles himself or others humble him — through this a decree of death is nullified from upon him.
Through humility — you will have no fear.
